brief: The canvas portrays a breathtaking, deep indigo cosmic expanse. The scene is dominated by a dense tapestry of starlight, featuring the soft, swirling blur of the Milky Way stretching across the void. Tiny, individual stars twinkle with varying intensity, creating a sense of immense cosmic depth. Occasionally, a burst of intense light erupts, representing a supernova, momentarily illuminating the dark, stellar vacuum before fading back into the pervasive starlight. The entire composition shifts and glows subtly, providing a hypnotic, slow flow of celestial motion.
